heroBody: A Computer Science student and Full-Stack Developer passionate about engineering impactful digital experiences. I build modern, scalable web applications using React, Next.js, Node.js, and Express.js — combining thoughtful design with robust engineering to turn ideas into powerful digital products.
aboutParagraphs: I’m Mohamed Ayman, a Full-Stack Developer and Computer Science student who builds robust, scalable web applications. I work across the stack, crafting responsive interfaces with React and Next.js and developing secure, efficient backends with Node.js and Express.js.

I care about the architecture and problem-solving behind great products. My goal is to turn complex ideas into practical, polished experiences, supported by reliable code and a thoughtful balance of functionality, performance, and long-term growth.
servicesIntro: Building seamless digital experiences through robust engineering and thoughtful design.
